sheet_from: Data/Item/jh03.OZT (64x128: a gilded frame with root-like scrollwork, its alpha cutting 36% away), jh01.OZJ (64x64, blue noise) and MMsSs_r.OZJ (64x64, blue lightning on black), from MuMain with pipeline/decode_texture.py; 96 triangles over three meshes. mmsss_back.png is ours, a flat 0.3 grey: the dark fill (see glow_note).
cutout_alpha_from: jh03.OZT's alpha is the frame's openings; keyed off the sheet's own alpha, not its brightness.
material_note: The frame is gilt scrollwork: brass, as the Dragon Shield, at 0.6. The dark fill under the lightning is MU's flat colour pass; painted_steel, so it reads as a dark lacquered face. Set per island (asset.sh's sheet_materials is the tiled path's, not an item's).
glow_note: RenderPartObjectBody (ZzzObject.cpp:8015-8034), which draws the shield mesh by mesh: mesh 2 (MMsSs_r) first in flat colour at 0.3 of the body light, then a chrome pass over it, then mesh 0 (jh03, the frame) solid, mesh 1 (jh01) added with its UVs jumping each frame (rand()%10*0.1, the Legendary Shield's shimmer), and last mesh 2 again added at sin(WorldTime*0.001)*0.4 + 0.6 of the light with its UVs sliding. Here: the flat colour is MMsSs_r_back, a copy of mesh 2's faces on a 0.3 grey (ours); jh01 a glow with jitter 0.1; MMsSs_r a glow at pulse [0.4, 0.6], the slow rate (content::Material::slowPulse). Not carried: the chrome pass and the lightning's slide (an item's glow cannot slide), and the blue BITMAP_SHINY+1 and BITMAP_LIGHT sprites MuMain hangs at bone 1 held (ZzzCharacter.cpp:7560-7567).
separate_meshes_why: MMsSs_r_back is mesh 2's own faces again; welded across meshes the two shells become duplicate faces and Blender keeps one (Wing05's trap).
rig_note: export-rig --actions=all: two bones, one action of one key; nothing moves, no rig kept (the held sprites at bone 1 are not built, and a rig would have to describe the MMsSs_r_back copy too). MuMain holds it as the Legendary Shield (ZzzCharacter.cpp:6883-6890).

islands.note: jh01, the blue noise: a glow.
